calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_web_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS non_member_web_sales,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_web_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_web_sales,

INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as web_records
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND f.sale_date >= '2025-12-22'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-03-22'

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  COUNT(*) as web_records,
  MIN(d.calendar_date) as min_date,
  MAX(d.calendar_date) as max_date
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_period_label,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS non_member_sales,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS member_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS member_share
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) as null_amounts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND f.net_amount IS NULL

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as member_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as guest_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
